question: Design a biochemical concentration-response experiment to measure inhibition of Serine/threonine-protein kinase mTOR (P42345) by CHEMBL1078983. Propose an ordered procedure, justify the assay format and parameters, and explicitly identify unsupported conditions; do not supply a remembered potency.

step_cards.action: Prepare a compound dilution series and vehicle/reference controls.
Combine compound, kinase, substrate and ATP; run the reaction under justified conditions.
For ADP-Glo: stop the reaction and deplete residual ATP, then perform the ADP detection reaction and measure luminescence.
Prepare the specified cell system, dilution series, vehicle, reference and background controls.
Expose cells to compound under justified culture conditions.
For CellTiter-Glo: apply the ATP-based viability reagent, mix and stabilize according to a supported procedure, then measure luminescence.
Normalize against appropriate controls, fit a concentration-response curve, and report uncertainty and assay limitations.

guidelines: Match the biological system and readout to the question.
Use controls and justify the concentration series and replicates.
Respect prerequisites of chosen step cards; justify any adaptations.
State unsupported conditions as unresolved; do not invent source support.
Cell viability alone does not establish a target-specific mechanism.
